NEWSLETTER
The newsletter which is being rolled out today marks the
launch of an effervescent activity that would enable the
Management to bring out to the eyes of the competitive world,
the academic achievements of our prestigious institution. SVCE
College of Engineering has grown in leaps and bounds, hurtling
across barriers along the way. This has been made possible
with the collaborative effort of the Management, the Staff and
the Students.
      I congratulate everyone for their commitment It is my
pleasure to congratulate the editorial board on this pleasant
occasion of releasing the newsletter for the period JULY to
NOV 2019. It is great to find a considerable number of winners
and participants in co-curricular and extracurricular activities
which certainly prove that our staff and students are
adequately equipped and possess necessary quality skill-sets to
bring such laurels to the institution.
I wish that this number may grow in the years to come. I am
sure that publishing a newsletter of this sort containing the
achievements of the SVCE family will be a recognition to them.
I wish them all the very best for future endeavors
MESSAGE FROM HOD
